name: Concoct
descriptionTemplate:
Each {Concoct} increases the {Cauldron} countdown by 3.
Each {Cauldron} can be Concocted up to [DescArg1] times ([DescArg2]/[DescArg1]).
If there is no {Cauldron} in hand: generate 1 {Cauldron} and select 1 type of Potion to make.
If a {Cauldron} is already in hand: instead, all of the Potion's effects are increased by 100%, and gain +1 {Boiling Anger} stack.
